definitions.core_principle: Every chart has at least one yoga period and one difficult period in its lifetime; when it arrives (age 10, 30, 50, 70...) depends on karma, read through the dasa sequence. The engine's job is to locate it.
definitions.star_lord_principle: A dasa lord gives the results of its nakshatra lord: e.g. Mercury dasa with Mercury in a Ketu star -> judge Ketu's condition.

rules.name: Dasa lord linked to own/exalted planets
rules.condition: dasa lord is connected (via star lord / dispositor) to own-sign or exalted planets, but is itself not the strongest
rules.result: Work continues but job satisfaction is partial (~75%); native compromises to keep the career running.

rules.name: Dhana lord in 9th, dispositor in 8th from it
rules.condition: lord_2 in 9th AND lord_2's dispositor in its own sign in the 8th from lord_2
rules.result: Debts through that dasa - genuine, honest debts, but the native stays a debtor until the dasa ends.

rules.name: Super-strong Ketu dasa
rules.condition: Ketu in the sign of an own-sign planet AND in the nakshatra of an exalted planet
rules.result: Ketu dasa is the yoga period - can earn in 7 years more than a preceding 17-year dasa; debts cleared. Pushes towards own business, not employment.
rules.note: 'Ketu spoils like no other' is overridden by Ketu's dispositor and star lord strength.

rules.name: Nodes with strong/retrograde planets
rules.condition: Rahu or Ketu connected with own-sign, exalted or retrograde planets
rules.result: Yoga. Retrogression of the linked planet does not reverse the result here.

rules.name: Job-change timing
rules.condition: Within a dasa linked to own/exalted planets, a bhukti of an own-sign planet (e.g. own-sign Jupiter) begins
rules.result: Compulsory job change in that bhukti; change in an earlier weaker bhukti only repeats the same position elsewhere - better to wait.

rules.name: Mars in 4th - late home
rules.result: Settles into own house only after middle age; purchase likely financed by a loan, typically in a debt-bringing bhukti.

rules.name: 4th lord strong
rules.condition: lord_4 in 4th, own sign or exalted, or in kendra/trikona

engine_output_suggestion.yoga_period_finder: For each mahadasa, score the dasa lord via its star lord and dispositor strength; report the highest-scoring dasa with its age range, and flag whether it falls in a useful life window (roughly 20-60).
engine_output_suggestion.warning: A yoga dasa arriving very late (65+) should be reported but noted as less usable.
